chunks: 131 - And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:

"Eight people are such that Allah does not accept salat (prayer) from them: the runaway slave until he returns to his master; the recalcitrant wife toward her husband while he is displeased with her; the withholder of zakat; the Imam of a people who leads them in prayer while they dislike him; the one who abandons wudu (ablution); the mature woman who prays without a head covering; the zibbīn, who is the one resisting urine and feces; and the intoxicated person."

key_terms.الزَّكَاةِ: zakat (obligatory alms-tax), whose withholding is condemned
key_terms.الزِّبِّينُ: one who is resisting the urge to urinate or defecate during prayer
key_terms.النَّاشِزُ: a wife acting rebelliously or recalcitrantly toward her husband
key_terms.الْآبِقُ: a runaway slave who has fled from his master
key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification required for prayer
key_terms.خِمَارٍ: head covering worn by a woman in prayer
key_terms.صَلَاةً: salat (prayer), the act of worship whose acceptance is being discussed

ai.seo_question: Whose salat (prayer) is not accepted according to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith lists eight categories of people whose salat (prayer) is not accepted, linking valid worship to obedience, ritual purity, proper dress, and sound bodily and mental state. It also connects acceptance of prayer with social and moral responsibilities, such as fulfilling spousal duties, paying zakat, and not leading people in prayer when they resent the leader.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
"Allah (swt) does not accept the prayer of eight types of people:
The runaway servant until he returns to his master,
The rebellious wife whose husband is displeased with her,
The one who withholds zakat,
The Imam whom people dislike to pray behind,
The one who neglects wudu,
The mature (of age) woman who prays without a head covering,
The one who prays while suppressing the urge to urinate or defecate (Zabeen),
And the one who is intoxicated."
